items.title: 3.1 Cells: zindagi ki bunyadi ikai (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of the chapter opening and topic 3.1, printed pages 48-49.

blocks.text: Cells zindagi ki bunyadi (basic) ikai (unit) hain aur har jandar (organism) inhi se bana hai. Yak-khalvi (unicellular) jandaron jaise amoeba aur bacteria mein ek hi cell zindagi ke tamam kaam karta hai. Kaseer-khalvi (multicellular) jandar, jaise poday aur janwar, bohat se makhsoos (specialised) cells se bante hain jo mil kar zindagi ko qaim rakhte hain.

blocks.title: Is chapter mein kya hai
blocks.text: Grade IX ki bunyad par yeh chapter cell theory, janwar aur poday ke cell ki banawat (structure), cell signalling, stem cells ki salahiyat (potential), aur membrane transport ke woh tareeqe (mechanisms) parhata hai jo cell ko chalate hain.

Aap jante hain ke tamam jandar zindagi ki saat bunyadi khususiyat (properties) dikhate hain: harkat (movement), tanaffus (respiration), homeostasis, numu (growth), afzaish (reproduction), ikhraj (excretion) aur ghiza (nutrition). Yehi khususiyat jandar ko jandar banati hain, aur cells hi woh tamam bunyadi kaam karte hain jo jandar ki pehchan hain.
Zindagi ki saat khususiyat, cell ki satah par

items: Harkat: cells harkat kar sakte hain. Sperm cells apne flagella se chalte hain; white blood cells infection se larne ke liye khoon mein safar karte hain; cell ke andar organelles zaroori kaam ke liye harkat karte hain.
Ghiza: cells apne mahol (environment) se ghizai ajza (nutrients) lete hain taake tawanai (energy) banayen, cell ki banawat tayyar karen aur biochemical reactions chalayen.
Tanaffus: cells tanaffus se tawanai banate hain. Is amal mein glucose toot kar ATP deta hai, jo tawanai ki currency hai aur cell ki sargarmiyon ko chalati hai.
Ikhraj: cells fuzla (waste) diffusion aur active transport se bahar nikalte hain taake zehreela (toxic) mawad jama na ho.
Homeostasis: cells apni membrane ke paar mawad ki harkat ko qaboo mein rakh kar andar ka mahol mustahkam (stable) rakhte hain.
Numu: cells ghizai ajza le kar unhen cell ke hisson mein badal kar barhte hain.
Afzaish: cells mitosis aur meiosis se barhte hain. Mitosis numu aur marammat (repair) ke liye ek jaise daughter cells banata hai, jabke meiosis jinsi afzaish ke liye gametes banata hai.

blocks.prompt: Ek akela bacterium aur ek insaan dono zinda hain. Saat khususiyat mein se kaun si akela bacterial cell khud anjam deta hai?
blocks.explanation: Saaton. Yak-khalvi jandar mein ek hi cell sab kuch karta hai: chalta hai, khata hai, tanaffus karta hai, fuzla nikalta hai, andar ka mahol qaim rakhta hai, barhta hai aur afzaish karta hai. Kaseer-khalvi jandar mein makhsoos cells yeh kaam aapas mein baant lete hain.

items: Cells zindagi ki bunyadi ikai hain; yak-khalvi jandar ek cell hain, kaseer-khalvi jandar bohat se makhsoos cells hain jo mil kar kaam karte hain.
Zindagi ki saat khususiyat (harkat, tanaffus, homeostasis, numu, afzaish, ikhraj, ghiza) sab cells anjam dete hain.
Tanaffus glucose se ATP nikalta hai; mitosis numu aur marammat ke liye ek jaise cells deta hai; meiosis gametes deta hai.
